robinhood.terms: Robinhood's own site icon; nominative use only.

bsc.terms: BNB Chain brand guidelines: use the official yellow mark unaltered; it must not imply endorsement or sponsorship by BNB Chain (case-by-case approval for anything more).
bsc.note: /chains/bnb.png (the BNB coin, from CoinGecko) is kept: server/tracker.mjs and scripts/gen-og.mjs still use it.

base.from: https://github.com/base/web/blob/master/apps/web/public/images/logo.svg (github.com/base org, the circle symbol: white notch path taken unaltered, on the Base blue #0000FF disc)
base.terms: Base brand kit (Coinbase). No licence file in the repo; use per Base's brand guide: unaltered marks, no implied partnership.
base.note: Replaces the flat blue Base_square_blue.svg from github.com/base/brand-kit (logo/TheSquare/Digital), which read as a plain square in the pay picker and receipt.

ethereum.terms: ethereum.org brand assets page, published for public use (ethereum.org repository is MIT licensed).

arbitrum.terms: Offchain Labs' own published Arbitrum logo (repo licence NOASSERTION). Arbitrum Foundation brand kit terms apply: unaltered, no implied affiliation. Used only to name Arbitrum as a Gully Pay payment network; the Gully Chains section keeps no Arbitrum marks.

hyperevm.terms: Hyperliquid's own app icon (resized 512 to 256 px); disc colour #042420 from hyperliquid.xyz. No published brand licence: nominative use only.

solana.terms: Solana Foundation brand assets: keep the artwork unaltered (no effects, outlines or recolouring); see the Foundation Brand Guidelines.

arc.terms: Circle Brand Use Policy (https://6778953.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/6778953/CircleBrandUsePolicy.pdf): Arc is a Circle mark; limited, unaltered, non-endorsing use only.

optimism.terms: Optimism brand resources page (OP Mainnet logo): the mark unaltered, with its own colours (#FF0421 tile, #FAFAF9 symbol); no implied endorsement. Our file is the mark cropped out of the 2500x1875 download (viewBox 841 529 817 817), nothing redrawn.

polygon.page: https://polygon.technology/brand-resources (the brand kit itself is a Google Drive folder)
polygon.terms: Polygon Labs' own served icon, unaltered; nominative use only to name Polygon as a Gully Pay payment network. Polygon brand guidelines: https://polygon.technology/brand-guidelines.

avalanche.terms: Ava Labs' own published AVAX logo (#E84142 disc), unaltered; Avalanche brand guidelines apply (no implied affiliation). Used only to name Avalanche as a Gully Pay payment network.
